Interface BindingMetadata

All Known Implementing Classes:
JsonbMetadata
public interface BindingMetadata
Binding annotations on a business object type and its members, as JSON-B defines them, read without referring to the JSON-B API.

get() reads JSON-B annotations when the JSON-B API is present at runtime, and nothing otherwise; a type annotated with JSON-B annotations can only load with the API present, so a type converted without it has none to read.
